rules: A through journey outside Servoz-Vallorcine, such as Chamonix-Saint-Gervais or Chamonix-Martigny, requires a ticket for the entire journey under the official guest-card flyer; do not subtract an internal free segment.
Chedde and Le Fayet are outside the internal Servoz-Vallorcine free-travel scope.

Léman Pass cross-border fares depend on OD, zones, class and age. Typical published validity is 90 minutes for border multizone products or 180 minutes for longer route products, with immediate activation in the TER sales channel.
Léman Pass single-ticket young band is ages 6-15; subscription young band is ages 6-25. Under-six cross-border travel is free under the published conditions.
Léman Express bicycle carriage is free for France-only journeys but requires a bicycle ticket for cross-border train journeys under the Léman Pass rules; operator conditions still apply.
uncertainties: The checked SNCF GTFS contains no fare files.
SNCF TGV/OUIGO open min/max price ranges are not a local TER tariff or live quote.
Older SNCF public dataset references bareme-de-prix-national-ter and tarifs-ter-aura returned HTTP 404 at checked v2.1 catalogue endpoints.
Rail discounts require a verified base fare and route-specific entitlement before a price can be calculated.
